fullContent:
Shringarabhra Ras 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali 
 INTRODUCTION 
 Shringarabhra Ras is an herbal formulation in the form of tablets. It is used to treat respiratory and digestive diseases. This medicine consists of heavy metal ingredients, therefore, it should be taken under medical supervision. This medication helps to balance three doshas. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Mica bhasma 
 Camphor (Cinnamomum camphora) 
 Nutmeg (Myristica fragrans) 
 Pavonia odorata 
 Gajapippali (Scindapsus aromaticum) 
 Patra (Cinnamomum tamala) 
 Clove (Syzigium aromaticum) 
 Nardostachys jatamansi 
 Talispatra (Abbies webbiana) 
 Cinnamon (Cinnamomum zeylanicum) 
 Nagkeshara (Mesua ferrea) 
 Kushta (Saussurea lappa) 
 Fire flame bush (Woodfordia fructicosa) 
 Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 
 Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica) 
 Amalaki (Emblica officinalis) 
 Saunth (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum) 
 Nutmeg peel (Myristica fragrans) 
 Purified sulphur 
 Purified mercury 
 Water 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean and grind all the ingredients using some water. When the mixture attains the consistency of a paste them make pills of 125 mg each. 
 Dosage 
 2 tablets in the morning with fresh ginger juice after meal. 
 Indications 
 
 Fever 
 Indigestion 
 Ascites 
 Anemia 
 Gastritis 
 Vomiting 
 Bleeding disorders 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Self-medication is not encouraged as it contains heavy metal ingredients. 
 Over dosage might lead to severe poisonous effects. 
 It should be avoided in pregnancy, lactation and children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
